notes:
Blue Lock: Rivals is a fan-made 5v5 soccer game based on the Blue Lock anime. Before a match you pick a Style, which is a character like Isagi or Bachira with their own dribbling, passing and shooting abilities. During the game you fill a meter to enter Flow, a powered-up state that makes your abilities stronger for a short time. Styles and Flows are both rolled with spins, and rarer ones are much stronger.

Codes here give Lucky Style Spins and Lucky Flow Spins, which have better odds at rare results than normal spins. Lucky Style Spins are usually the better pick, because your Style decides your whole kit on the pitch. New codes come with each update, new Style release or delay, and they are posted in the Discord codes channel. Many of them only last a few days.

faq.q: Why does every code fail for me?
faq.a: Blue Lock: Rivals only lets players at level 10 or above redeem codes. Play a few matches to level up and try again.

faq.q: What is the difference between Lucky Style Spins and Lucky Flow Spins?
faq.a: Style spins roll for the character you play as, and Flow spins roll for your powered-up Flow mode. The lucky versions have better odds at rare results than normal spins.

faq.q: Why did a code from last week stop working?
faq.a: Most codes in this game are tied to one update and get removed when the next one comes out, sometimes after only a day or two.

tips: Play a few matches early to reach level 10, then redeem codes. The spins help much more once you know which Style you like playing.
Fill your Flow meter during the match and save it for an important attack. Flow makes your abilities stronger for a short time, so use it near the goal.
Pass to open teammates instead of dribbling into crowds. In a 5v5 match, smart passing creates more chances than solo runs.
Learn your Style's abilities in casual matches before you rely on them. Every Style plays a little differently on the pitch.
